I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is **#8841**.

Where it came from: Tobias posted in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27) that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is a member of that channel, so she could already see the message.

One thing isn't confirmed. Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I'm linking the two because of a January agent note saying Marrow Fieldworks, Pree's dealer account then, changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. That note doesn't say who took it over. So I suggested Pree check with Tobias before the call, and told her I hadn't found any other ticket for this issue.

The shared files folder for accounts was empty, so I had no ticket records to check against. I only read channels Pree belongs to and stayed out of her DMs and anything else she can't see.
